message:
Command `cd /workspace/_work/src && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/tmp/poc2.md')
p.write_text('> | a | b |\n> |---|---|\n> [!NOTE]\n> x\n')
PY
./build.sh 'cd /workspace/_work/src && cmake -S . -B build >/dev/null && cmake --build build -j2 >/dev/null && printf "\x00\x01\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x08\x00\x00\x00\x00" > /tmp/flags.bin && cat /tmp/flags.bin /tmp/poc2.md > /tmp/case.bin && ./build/md2html --replay-fuzz /tmp/case.bin >/tmp/out.txt 2>/tmp/err.txt; echo EXIT:$?; cat /tmp/err.txt; head -20 /tmp/out.txt'` executed with exit code 127.
